title: Multiplicative tensor-power maps from a line bundle into an algebra sheaf
statement: For a scheme X, an invertible O_X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module], a commutative algebra sheaf B [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], and a module map j:L to U(B), there exist maps b_d:L.tensorPow d to U(B). The degree-zero map sends a structure-sheaf section r to the structure image of r, the degree-one map equals the right unitor followed by j, and b_a(s)b_d(t)=b_(a+d)(tensorPowAddIso(a,d).inv(tmulSection(s,t))) on every open. The powers and sections use the existing source-library monoidal tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Section 01CF, tensor and symmetric algebras; also coherent.tex, Tag 09MS, the direct-sum algebra

proof.text:
Multiplication of sections is bilinear over the structure sheaf and commutes with
restriction. The presheaf tensor-product universal property, followed by the module
sheafification adjunction, gives a map U(B) tensor U(B) to U(B). Define b_0 by the
structure map and b_(n+1) by j tensor b_n followed by this multiplication map. The unit
law identifies b_1 with j after the right unitor. Induct on a in the multiplication
formula: a=0 is the left unit law, including the zero_add transport in tensorPowAddIso;
the successor case uses its recursive associator formula and associativity of section
multiplication. Equality of maps from sheaf tensor products can be tested on elementary
tensors before sheafification. For three factors, locally choose a frame of L; every
section of L tensor N is then an elementary tensor, and sheaf separation globalizes
the calculation. The zero algebra, degree zero and empty open obey the same laws.

lean.statement: theorem exists_commAlgebraSheaf_tensorPower_maps {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (j : L ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B) : ∃ b : ∀ d : ℕ, L.tensorPow d ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B, (∀ (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)), (b 0).app U (unitSectionsEquiv U r) = B.hom.hom.app (op U) r) ∧ b 1 = (ρ_ L).hom ≫ j ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U)) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow d, U)), (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b a).app U s) * (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b d).app U t) = (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b (a + d)).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U (tmulSection s t)))
